name: Tabbed post lists
purpose: Two or three tabs, each with a list of posts, such as Recent and Popular. Follows the ARIA tabs pattern with arrow key support. Without script the lists show one under another.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Accessible name for the tab list.

inputs.name: uid
inputs.description: Short id that keeps element ids unique when the item is used twice on one page.

inputs.name: tabs
inputs.description: Tabs. Each holds a label, an id and a list of posts.

field_notes.rows: pre-rendered list items: li elements with a.sc-tp-a links

verified_in: headless Chrome/Edge at 360 px and 1280 px
